clauses.clause: On natural code-generation tasks, allocating a fixed budget of stricter execution checks across groups first, then expanding checks within groups where an accepted error was found, can improve held-out complete-program success
clauses.obtained: Untested held-out learning improvement. Reviewer-accepted candidate seed0 has 63 real optimizer updates, then insufficient_retained_batch; the 100-update endpoint was not reached and the required 39-task validation was not run. This CPU-only public-trace diagnosis adds no model work or evaluation and does not change the Working claim.

Untested superiority over equally budgeted uniform. New candidate-only descriptive analysis of all 380 groups finds 34 raw-mixed groups made all-zero by purchased corrections, 131 mixed preserved, 11 mixed created and 204 neither mixed. These are partial-label transitions, not a paired learning comparison; no uniform outcome was read or generated.

Untested superiority over a strong CARE adaptation. This task diagnoses only the incomplete 63-update candidate; it neither reads nor interrupts the running CARE task or infers CARE readiness/outcomes. Reviewer directly observed that the disputed historical command carries CARE task item_id 96a7237f3242 and separately mapped candidate task 02b9996432a5 to session 01a17bb4-3e01-7a53-a23b-4edb6ffdcbcc. CARE task attribution is supported; its exact session_id/original call_id mapping remains unavailable. This attributed observation does not retroactively change the Engineer missing-file record or prove blanket session isolation.

Untested learning per verification cost. Existing actual candidate totals reconcile to 607 strict purchases, 1520 responses, 434487 generated and 183251 training tokens. The censored final window costs 26 purchases/64 responses/19290 generated tokens and zero updates. No held-out learning gain or cost-normalized comparison is available; the proposed 8+8-window trial is unexecuted.

clauses.clause: The proposed reason is task-level heterogeneity in the stricter checker’s rejection of base-accepted programs: one observed rejection can make further checks in that group more useful
clauses.obtained: Partial only from the original natural fixed-policy offline pool: candidate-minus-uniform mean per-task advantage residual -0.00864401943, with favorable/equal/adverse collection pairs 74/1619/35. The new adaptive candidate trajectory shows task composition and paid corrections both accompany a low-contrast stopping window, but uses partial labels and few repeats per task; it does not isolate triggering, establish learning improvement or add causal mechanism evidence.
